reason: User authentication is required at the start of the conversation via email or name+zip before providing any account info, and this must be done even if the user provides a user id directly. The user supplied email isabella.lopez3271@example.com, the assistant called find_user_id_by_email which returned isabella_lopez_6490, completing authentication. The candidate action get_user_details(user_id='isabella_lopez_6490') is a read-only information retrieval about the now-authenticated user's own profile/orders, which the policy explicitly permits ('provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products') and is needed to answer the user's gift card balance and payment method questions. No database-modifying action is being taken, so no confirmation step is required yet. Nothing in the policy prohibits looking up user details right after authentication.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products
